scope: Repair an observed training numerical failure; engineering fixture, no new research hypothesis or performance claim
checks: raw RGB range, official V1 normalization and tensor shape
label map and range, mean cross entropy on logits
finite exact official pretrained state and deterministic37class head initialization
fixed BN running statistics and identical init across original/repaired arms

original_reproduction.purpose: record original unsafe trajectory until first nonfinite loss; allow original update behavior only in disposable diagnostic model

first_repair.guard: refuse optimizer step on nonfinite loss/gradient; assert updated parameters finite

success: actual nonzero backbone and head parameter updates; all repaired loss/grad/params finite; final repeated-training-batch loss below70%initial; lean training timed separately
weights_not_to_save: discard overfit fixture models; retain hashes and logs only
